summary: Lofi hip hop ('lofi girl' beats): 70–90 BPM boom-bap drums, jazzy 7th-chord vamps on Rhodes, with production/lofi
body: Boom-bap's genre (genre/boom-bap) treated with production/lofi: the two together.
Drums: swung, quiet, a little late; hats soft. Harmony: two-chord vamps of 7ths and 9ths (vi7–IVmaj7, ii7–V7).
Sounds: soft Rhodes or a sampled piano, a round sub, maybe vinyl crackle.
Toward it gradually: drums first, then chords, then the lofi treatment, then ease the tempo down.

Apply: pattern/boombap-1 on the drums, then pattern/lofi-vamp-vi-iv on the keys four bars later, plus the production chain on the master. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 70–90 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.
